models.summary: As we explained earlier, EV manufacturers aim to appeal to their environmentally conscious customers by providing good values and reducing environmental impacts, and thus, we explore the research question of whether flexible battery leasing can reduce the total customer cost and/or the total battery capacity (as a proxy for its environmental impact) in addition to improving the manufacturer profit. We solve this problem by backward induction. Acquiring additional high-capacity batteries may alleviate customer battery oversubscription and help customers reduce cost, but it does not improve battery utilization; only battery reallocation can help improve battery utilization.
